searchText: I just put together a basic history pruner. I'll need to modify it to work on testnets. I'm not sure what Besu will do if it tries to access the pre-merge data and finds it missing... that may require a bit more effort to make sure it doesn't just explode Do we need to propose a transaction maximum gas EIP before we get too excited about 90m gas blocks? Should one TX be able to burn 90m gas? It was a major concern in Bangkok. It just makea scaling more predictable You mean like this? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7825 We need to confirm CL client readiness Yes, can it be added to the Fusaka sorting pile? - https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7607 Its proposed for inclusion
